steps.note: First +chargen initializes the character and shows the method menu.
streetrat = preset stats for your role. complete = full 62-point stat buy.
Pick the Solo role. Role determines career skills and streetrat stat presets.
Auto-roll the region and language table. The result is saved to your lifepath.
Don't like your roll? Designate a specific result instead.
Read the full entry for any result before committing.

Enemies use a two-phase roll: first roll gives the count (1d10-7, min 0).
Now roll once per enemy. Each roll generates WHO + CAUSE + RESOURCES.
